structured.answer: I've got Harel's whole list now: 96 tracks across 7 product types. Most cost around 0.4% to 0.67%. The S&P 500 tracks did best, about 13.7% over 3 years and 11.9% over 5, at about 0.5% to 0.56% (the קרן השתלמות one is 0.5%). Over 3 or 5 years in total or per year? Not sure. If I moved anything it'd be the S&P one, but the page doesn't say which product my money is in.

stuck.where: Screen 1, header row of the table
stuck.why: The column headings are in small grey text and there are three numbers per row. Took me a while to see that the right one is the fee and the left one is how big the fund is.

stuck.where: Return column, 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים'
stuck.why: Half the tracks show no return at all, just 'less than 3 years'. I can't compare them, so I just skipped those.
Not sure if that's per year or the total over 3 years. I read it as about 13% a year, but I'm guessing.

stuck.where: קרן חדשה מקיפה / כללית sections, screens 3-5
stuck.why: It says 0.16% 'מהחיסכון', which is the cheapest on the page, and then '1.47%' 'מההפקדה' under it. 1.47% looks big and scary. Is that one cheap or expensive?
It's endless. Row after row with the same names again and again (מניות, כללי, עוקב S&P 500) under different headings. Around screen 3 I'd have quit on the bus.
The fees here split into קבועים / משתנים / נאמן and there are tags like צוברת and מנוטרלת מט"ח. Lost me there.

קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל tables

'צוברת', 'מנוטרלת מט"ח', 'חשיפה לדולר', 'מס נגד על שינויי המטבע', '(4A)', '(4D)'
'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים', 'מרכזית לפיצויים', 'קרן חדשה מקיפה' vs 'כללית'

not_found: Which of these products my savings are actually in
A recommendation or 'start here' for someone like me
Clear words on whether the return is per year
A button to actually join or move money

findings.what: Way too long: about 96 rows that look the same, with the same track names repeated in every product. On a phone I'd give up halfway.
Most tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so there's nothing to compare
Two fees per row, and the second (1.47% מההפקדה) is much bigger than the first. Confusing and a bit scary; no idea what it costs me in shekels.
Doesn't say if '13.7% 3 שנים' is per year or the total
Orange warning mark with 'עוד לא דווח' made me nervous about that track
findings.where: תגמולים section, 'דקל קופת גמל לדמי מחלה'

findings.what: Header row is small grey text, so it's hard to know which number is what
Funds tables use fee words I don't know (קבועים/משתנים/נאמן) and coloured tags
Nothing tells me what to do first, or which product is mine
